o.text: From Arabic نُقْطَة (nuqṭa). The sense retail location is probably a semantic loan from Russian то́чка (tóčka). See Turkish nokta.
Internationalism; via Russian мона́рхия (monárxija), from Ancient Greek μοναρχία (monarkhía), from μόνος (mónos, “only”) + ἀρχή (arkhḗ, “power, authority”).
Calque of Persian تشریف بردن (literally “bring honor”).
